caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of different triggers, with the x-axis labeled with trigger words and the y-axis representing ASR values. The x-axis is categorical, with trigger words listed in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model, and includes the labels "bb", "mb", "cf", "beautiful", "excellent", "gorgeous", "wonderful", "brilliant", "stunning", and "beautifully". The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and has a scale type that appears to be linear, with a value range of 0.2 to 0.9 and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Three lines are plotted: one in green, representing "start", one in orange, representing "random", and one in purple, representing "end". The green line starts at approximately 0.2 for "bb" and ends at around 0.85 for "beautifully", with a peak at "mb" around 0.75 and a decline to around 0.4 for "cf". The orange line starts at approximately 0.55 for "bb" and ends at around 0.85 for "beautifully", with a low point at "cf" around 0.2 and an increase to around 0.6 for "excellent". The purple line starts at approximately 0.5 for "bb" and ends at around 0.8 for "beautifully", with fluctuations across the x-axis, including a peak at "wonderful" around 0.9 and a dip at "brilliant" around 0.7.
